resolution.note: verify targeted step runs changed tests under CI=true KRN_REQUIRE_ZERO_ISOLATION_SKIPS=1 with the pinned Node

title: Verify runs changed tests under the CI guest's strict zero-skip evidence
body:
Outcome: krn verify catches a changed test that skips in the CI guest before push. PR #226 went red twice in krn/gate: the guest sets KRN_REQUIRE_ZERO_ISOLATION_SKIPS=1 and CI=true (infra/ci/internal/executor/guest.go:27) and strict test evidence rejects any skip, but verify's targeted step and npm run gate locally do neither.
Proof: an observer gives verify a changed test that calls t.skip via an approved path and asserts the targeted step fails naming strict evidence.
